method: Each register is written a different legal value from its own declared domain and the result read back from a refresh dump. An echo on the written path is never waited for: the device answers a linked pair on the partner path and is silent on the one addressed. Passes are split by channel parity so a linked pair is never written against itself, writes are paced because a burst is dropped, and every register gets three attempts. Each pass restores its direct writes and repairs permitted partner effects before the next pass; unresolved drift stops probing. A final repair also checks the full state. Protected changes are reported, never written back. Judgement uses parameter encoding, not a tolerance derived from the probe step. 'clamped' is the legacy name for a changed-but-wrong report, not a diagnosis.
